brands.name: Deepest Reaches
brands.short_description: Deepest Reaches is Kyle Albers' Irvine based label making some of the most uniquely conceived and wildly versatile alternative surfboards in California, with his iconic Mega Fish leading the charge.

models.name: Mega Fish
models.description:
Very versatile design for effortless speed, paddle power, and easy turning. Can be ridden in tiny to large surf. Proportioned as a midlength or glider. Turn from the tail, trim in the middle.

Features:
Low rocker
Tucked rails
Tri-plane bottom (double concave with vee off rails)

Size range: 6'0 - 12'0

models.name: Fish
models.description:
The same bottom, rails, and rocker as the Mega Fish but in classic fish proportions (short/wide). Very fast and rippable.

Size range: 5'0 - 6'6

models.name: Pizzabox
models.description:
Shorter and wider than a fish with the same tri-plane bottom for extreme planing speed and looseness.

Size range: 5'0 - 6'0

models.name: Kozmk Krzr
models.description:
Single fin for most waves. Winged pintail, flat deck, tucked under edge, spiral vee bottom. Flex fin.

Features:
Tucked rails
